visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a neutral-toned beige button-up shirt, stands in a modern, well-lit white kitchen. She reaches toward a built-in wooden drawer and opens it to retrieve several transparent food storage containers. The background is clean and bright with white cabinetry. (2) On the white countertop, she arranges various ingredients including a large jar of dry oats, a container of Greek yogurt, a bag of cocoa granola, and several clear glass containers. The lighting is soft and professional, highlighting the various textures and labels of the food items. (3) The woman uses a small white spoon to transfer dry rolled oats from a large glass jar into three separate clear glass containers. She focuses on the task, ensuring an even layer of oats is distributed across the bottom of each container while standing upright. (4) She carefully sprinkles black chia seeds and a fine white collagen powder over the oat layers using a small white plastic scoop. The camera captures her hands and the ingredients in a close-up shot, showing the contrast between the dark seeds and the white powders. (5) Fresh white milk is poured from a large plastic jug into each of the glass containers, just enough to submerge the dry ingredients. Her steady hands and the pouring action are the central focus, while the bright kitchen environment remains visible in the background. (6) In a separate white ceramic bowl, she uses a black spatula to mix thick white Greek yogurt with dark cocoa powder until it forms a smooth, dark brown cream. She then carefully spoons this chocolate yogurt mixture on top of the soaked oat layers. (7) A yellow banana is peeled and placed on a grey cutting board where she slices it into thin, even rounds with a silver kitchen knife. She then uses her fingers to carefully arrange the banana slices in a flat layer over the chocolate yogurt. (8) The woman adds another thin layer of dry oats followed by a final generous layer of the dark chocolate yogurt mixture. The side view of the containers shows an aesthetically pleasing layered effect of white, brown, and pale yellow against the glass. (9) For the final garnish, she sprinkles a dark, crunchy cocoa granola with dried berries from a MUJI branded package onto the top of each container. She then takes the transparent plastic lids and firmly snaps them onto the glass containers to seal them. (10) The woman carries the three prepared containers to the refrigerator and places them neatly on a middle shelf next to other household food items. The video ends with a clear shot of the finished product resting inside the cool, brightly lit fridge.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful female voice begins the narration in Traditional Chinese, characterized by a friendly tone and clear articulation. The sound of a wooden kitchen drawer sliding open is clearly heard, immediately followed by the start of a bright, upbeat acoustic guitar and light percussion background track. (2) The speaker introduces the recipe while the crisp sound of a glass jar's lid being unscrewed and the subtle crinkling of a plastic food bag provide incidental texture. The BGM maintains a steady, moderate tempo that provides a rhythmic foundation for the instructional speech. (3) As oats are measured into glass containers, the rhythmic sound of a plastic spoon tapping against glass is heard in synchronization with the fast-paced editing. The narrator's voice remains consistently focused and energetic, providing specific details about each ingredient and its proportion. (4) A series of short, soft grainy sounds accompany the pouring of chia seeds and collagen powder. The recording environment is exceptionally quiet with no audible background hum, allowing the delicate sounds of the food preparation to stand out against the melodic guitar track. (5) A resonant, liquid splashing sound is heard as milk is poured into the jars, creating a brief peak in acoustic texture. The female voice continues without pause, maintaining a high speech density that guides the viewer through the quick succession of visual steps. (6) The metallic and scraping sound of a spatula mixing yogurt in a ceramic bowl is layered over the BGM. The voice takes on a more descriptive quality, expressing a personal preference for cocoa powder as the acoustic brightness of the music swells slightly during the transition. (7) Sharp, percussive 'clack' sounds of a silver knife hitting a cutting board occur rapidly as a banana is sliced. These transients are clean and well-defined, suggesting either a high-quality field recording or carefully placed post-production sound effects to emphasize the action. (8) The narrator concludes the instructions with a warm, inviting question about the food's appearance. The sound of plastic lids snapping onto glass jars provides a series of high-frequency transients that mark the completion of the assembly phase of the recipe. (9) The audio concludes with the low-pitched thud of a refrigerator door closing and a final enthusiastic closing remark from the speaker. The acoustic guitar music fades out quickly, leaving a clean silence that highlights the high production quality of the overall audio track.
